items.title: Cyber Tunnel
items.description: Neon cyan rings in perspective around a magenta core. Bass warps the tunnel, mids lift the glow.

items.title: Iridescent Orb
items.description: A floating pearlescent sphere with a rim and a gloss. Bass pulses it, mids make it wobble.

items.title: Hyperspace Tunnel
items.description: Radial stars and light streaks. The warp speeds up on the beat.

items.title: Liquid Glass
items.description: A frosted glass panel with chromatic dispersion. Sound pulses the refraction.

items.title: Hex Lattice
items.description: An isometric honeycomb grid, warm at the centre. Ripples run out across the hexagons.

items.title: Phyllotaxis Bloom
items.description: Seeds on a golden-angle spiral. Sound pushes the orbits outward.

items.title: Metaball Lens
items.description: Three liquid blobs with a specular rim. Their radii breathe with the sound.

items.title: Ordered Dither
items.description: A 4x4 Bayer halftone in one colour. Sound ripples the threshold.

items.title: Pixel Plate
items.description: Stepped mosaic tiles. Sound steps the tile colours.

items.title: Harmonic Warp
items.description: Interfering sine ripples that displace one another with the harmonics.

items.title: Hyper Torus
items.description: A wireframe slice of a rotating 4D torus. Ring frequency follows the sound.

items.title: Spectrum Bars
items.description: Perspective equaliser bars with a floor reflection. Each bar follows a band of the sound.

items.title: Kaleidoscope Mirror
items.description: An eight-fold mirrored crystal. Bass spins it, highs sharpen the facets.

items.title: Neon Matrix
items.description: A synthwave perspective floor under a low sun. The sun swells with the bass.

items.title: Audio Waveform
items.description: A circular oscilloscope ribbon ringed by spectrum bars.

items.title: Fractal Flame
items.description: A recursive, folded flame. Sound drives the fold and the glow.

items.title: Chladni Cymatics
items.description: Resonant 2D standing wave nodal lines on a circular plate. Sound shifts the modal geometry.

items.title: Quantum Vortex
items.description: Relativistic swirling energy vortex with audio-reactive event horizon warping and chromatic accretion glow.

items.title: Pulsar Beam
items.description: Rotating magnetized neutron star with relativistic synchrotron light cones, dipole magnetic flux arcs and audio-reactive horizon flare.

items.title: Neural Synapse
items.description: A lattice of glowing dendrites. Sound fires pulses along the branches and flares at the synapses.

items.title: Aurora Borealis
items.description: Luminous polar aurora borealis ionospheric curtains with audio-reactive magnetic fold undulations and spectral ray striations.

items.title: Cosmic Nebula
items.description: Deep interstellar emission nebula with audio-reactive volumetric dust filaments, ionized stellar core ionization and radiant cluster flare.

items.title: Spectral Caustics
items.description: Deep aquatic light caustics with audio-reactive chromatic dispersion, fluid wave refraction and incandescent focal flare.

items.title: Plasma Filament
items.description: High-energy electrical plasma arcs with audio-reactive magnetic twist undulations, helical flux filaments and incandescent core discharge.

items.title: Solar Flare
items.description: Blinding coronal solar flares with twisting magnetic loop prominences, turbulent convection granulation and audio-reactive coronal mass ejections.

items.title: Gravitational Lensing
items.description: Relativistic black hole gravitational lensing with Einstein rings, warped starfield caustics, Doppler-boosted accretion disk and audio-reactive photon sphere.
